variants.label: A
variants.subject: new clients for {{company_name}}
variants.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Most creative agencies I talk to do brilliant work and win most of it through word of mouth.

We help agencies like {{company_name}} build a second channel: we find brands that need what you do, write to them in your voice, and book the intro calls for you.

Would a short call to see if it fits be useful?

Priya

variants.label: B
variants.subject: past the referral ceiling
variants.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

There is usually a point where referrals stop keeping up with how much an agency wants to grow.

If {{company_name}} is close to that point, we can help. We run outbound end to end and only charge for meetings that happen.

Open to hearing how it works?

Priya

variants.subject: {{first_name}}, three brands for you
variants.body:

I found three brands that look like a strong fit for {{company_name}}'s work and seem to be looking for a new creative partner.

Happy to send the names and why I picked them, no strings attached.

Shall I?

Priya
